posts.title: Cave Guwange Repair
posts.description: In for repair was a clean Cave Guwange board with faulty graphics. These boards use a powerful sprite engine consisting of four SMD ROM chips feeding into a large custom chip labeled 013. The rendered sprite data passes from 013 into two 512kb SRAM chips functioning as a frame buffer – the two SRAM chips [...]

posts.title: Cave CV1000 Board Repair
posts.description: In for repair is a Cave CV-1000 PCB where the colors are displaying dim with a yellow tinge. As per the PCB Encyclopedia, it is common for the three (U14=Red, U15=Green, U16=Blue) color amplifiers to fail on these boards.
